response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT r.insurstat, r.ratio, r.mesh_count, a.avg_ratio FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio) SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_count) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(ratio - avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A site's mesh record count includes all of its scanmesh rows, even those whose ratio is missing (NULL values or zero geomdeltamm, which SQLite divides to NULL).
Sites with no mesh records are excluded, since only sites with matching mesh records are considered.
A missing insurance status means insurstat IS NULL; empty strings are treated as a real status value.
